name: Garlic Herb Pork Tenderloin Medallions
steps: Slice the pork into medallions and rub with garlic, herbs and mustard.
Sear in oil 3 minutes a side.
Roast the asparagus alongside for 10 minutes.

name: Pork Chops with Mushroom Pan Sauce
steps: Sear the seasoned chops in oil; set aside.
Brown the mushrooms and garlic in butter, add broth and thyme and reduce.
Return the chops and simmer 6 minutes.

name: Grilled Sirloin with Chimichurri and Roasted Zucchini
steps: Grill the steak to taste and rest.
Chop the parsley with garlic, vinegar, oil and oregano.
Roast the zucchini slices and serve everything together.

name: Italian Beef Stew with Peppers and Tomatoes
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, peppers, tomatoes, broth and seasoning.
Simmer covered 100 minutes until tender.

name: Steak Tips with Garlic Butter Mushrooms
steps: Sear the cubed steak in a hot pan, 2 minutes a side, and set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in butter with garlic.
Return the steak and finish with parsley.

name: Beef and Vegetable Kebabs
steps: Marinate the beef cubes in oil, spices and lemon.
Thread onto skewers with the vegetables.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning.

name: Lamb Burgers with Feta and Cucumber Yogurt
steps: Mix the lamb with feta, garlic, cumin and half the mint and shape four patties.
Grill 5 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt with grated cucumber and the rest of the mint.
Serve in lettuce with the sauce.

name: Slow Cooker Lamb Shoulder with Rosemary and Garlic
steps: Stud the lamb with garlic and rosemary.
Set on the onion and carrots in the slow cooker with broth and lemon.
Cook on low 7 hours.

name: Greek Lamb Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix the lamb, egg, oat bran, garlic and oregano and shape meatballs.
Brown, then simmer in the marinara 15 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Ground Beef and Cabbage Skillet
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add the cabbage, paste, broth and paprika.
Cook covered 12 minutes.

name: Taco-Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve and scoop out the zucchini.
Brown the beef with the seasoning and sauce.
Fill the boats, top with cheddar and bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

name: Beef Stir-Fry with Snap Peas and Peppers
steps: Toss the sliced steak in arrowroot and sear in oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger.
Combine with soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Meatball Marinara Bake with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Mix the meats, egg, parmesan and seasoning and shape meatballs.
Bake in the marinara at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Top with mozzarella and serve over the zucchini noodles.

name: Pork Carnitas Bowls with Cabbage and Lime
steps: Rub the pork with the spices and slow cook with orange juice and garlic for 7 hours.
Shred and crisp under the broiler.
Serve over cabbage with lime, avocado and cilantro.

name: Pozole Rojo with Pork
steps: Simmer the pork with the onion, garlic, chili powder, oregano and broth for 70 minutes.
Add the beans and cook 15 minutes.
Serve with cabbage, radish and lime.

name: Barbacoa-Style Beef Tacos
steps: Slow cook the beef with chipotle, lime, cumin, garlic and onion for 7 hours.
Shred and serve in warm tortillas with cilantro.

name: Grilled Pork Souvlaki with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the pork cubes in lemon, garlic, oregano and oil.
Skewer and grill 10 to 12 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with grated cucumber, dill and garlic.
Serve in warm pitas.

name: Italian Sausage with Peppers and Onions over Polenta-Style Grits
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the peppers, onion and marinara and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over grits stirred with parmesan.

name: Pork Chops with Sauteed Apples and Onions
steps: Sear the chops in oil; set aside.
Cook the apple and onion in butter with thyme.
Add the vinegar, return the chops and simmer 6 minutes.

name: Corned Beef-Style Brisket with Cabbage and Carrots
steps: Simmer the beef in the broth with vinegar, onion, bay and pepper for 2 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots for 30 minutes, then the cabbage for the last 20.

name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
steps: Mix the beef, egg, oat bran and mustard and form oval patties; brown.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the pan, add broth thickened with arrowroot.
Return the patties and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Moroccan-Spiced Lamb with Chickpeas
steps: Brown the cubed lamb with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, chickpeas and broth and simmer 80 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Beef and Bean Burrito Bowls
steps: Brown the beef with the seasoning.
Build bowls from rice, beans, beef and lettuce.
Top with tomato, avocado, cheddar and salsa.

name: Hawaiian Pork Chops with Pineapple Salsa
steps: Rub the chops with paprika and oil and grill 6 minutes a side.
Mix the pineapple, onion, cilantro, lime and jalapeno.
Serve the salsa over the chops.

name: Spicy Pork Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and ginger.
Add the water chestnuts, soy sauce and sriracha.
Spoon into lettuce cups with green onion and sesame oil.

name: Venison Chili
steps: Brown the venison with the onion and garlic.
Add the spices, tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 50 minutes.

name: Bison Meatloaf with Mushrooms
steps: Sauté the chopped mushrooms and onion.
Mix with the bison, egg, oat bran and salt and press into a loaf pan.
Spread with paste and bake at 375°F for 50 minutes.
